limitations: G0 complete-evaluation accounting is not closed, so no ReSETP performance comparison is authorized.
No official source code was verified for the 2018 dynamic ALNS, 2024 multi-depot dynamic ALNS, route-stability pBiALNS or online ejection-chain papers.
RoutingBlocks has MIT text in source headers but no root repository LICENSE file.
PyVRP warm start is not hard route freezing.
dvrpsim is a simulator and state interface, not a routing algorithm.
OR-Tools partial route locking does not by itself implement the complete ReSETP energy, charging, fairness and carbon semantics.
user_approval_required_for: any dependency linked into or distributed with the formal repository
any change to objective, acceptance, stability metric or budget accounting
any mechanism ablation or formal experiment arm
any merge into the formal ALNS or E7 runner
recommended_exploration_scope_under_EA00: Run only four isolated micro-probes first: current-state pseudo-depot round-trip, OR-Tools frozen-prefix preservation, bounded regret-ejection activity and accounting, and independent route-stability metric recomputation. Formal integration remains approval-gated.
